answer_1.quote: The continued advancement of vision-language models has enabled the direct generation of medical reports from imaging data.

answer_2.quote: We applied multiple existing evaluation metrics to all constructed report pairs.

answer_3.quote: LLM-based metrics such as GREEN, GEMA Score, MRScore, and ReFINE leverage the six error categories defined in the ReXVal dataset to construct structured scoring tables.

answer_4.quote: Six radiologists annotated 50 ground‑truth and generated report sets (each set comprising one ground‑truth and four candidate reports), labeling the number of errors per report across six predefined categories.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators labeled the number of errors per report, classified each error as clinically significant or insignificant.
